request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. A real photograph of a whiteboard for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. The board shows only numbers: no month names, no day names, no letters and no words anywhere, in any language. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames added, no padding, watermark or captions.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one mark added. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered boxes. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, the same board and wooden frame, the year at the top, every box number from 1 to 12 in the same place and every small grid of day squares. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this, drawn by hand with a dark-blue whiteboard pen, with slightly uneven ink like real handwriting: ONE freehand loop around the whole of box 6 (the second box of the middle row), enclosing its number 6 and its day squares, slightly asymmetric with a small overlapping end stroke. Also add one adult hand that reaches in from the right edge of the photo and holds a dark-blue whiteboard marker whose tip touches the end of that loop, as if it has just drawn it; the hand and marker do not cover any box number. No other box is looped: exactly one blue loop on the board. The hand has five natural fingers.
